def pixel_to_world_cv(u, v, z, K, T):
    x = (u - K[0, 2]) * z / K[0, 0]
    y = (v - K[1, 2]) * z / K[1, 1]
    p_cam = [x, y, z, 1.0]
    p_w = [
        sum(T[i][j] * p_cam[j] for j in range(4)) for i in range(3)
    ]
    return p_w


def pixel_to_world_gl(u, v, z, K, T):
    x = (u - K[0, 2]) * z / K[0, 0]
    y = -(v - K[1, 2]) * z / K[1, 1]
    p_cam = [x, y, -z, 1.0]
    p_w = [
        sum(T[i][j] * p_cam[j] for j in range(4)) for i in range(3)
    ]
    return p_w
